milestones.title: NEEDS-MARK: explicit mission policy and fail-closed sandbox extension
acceptance_criteria: Mark separately approves or routes changes under tools/pi-extensions/**, which is outside the fleet push allowlist
Mission policy is explicitly supplied, validated, and never replaced by defaults when missing or malformed
Sandbox initialization failure blocks bash and user_bash; readiness is emitted only after successful initialization
Focused extension tests cover valid, missing, malformed, disabled, and failed-initialization cases

milestones.title: Wire both extensions and tracked policy into the mission pi runner
acceptance_criteria: Derive main checkout from git common dir, verify source parity and dependency, and pass both absolute -e paths
Generate validated policy in a private temp directory with worktree gitdir and common objects allowed; do not dirty the worktree
Set PI_FENCE_ROOT and readiness env, create /tmp/claude, and propagate pi exit status
Typed verdicts distinguish sandbox_unavailable rc 15, sandbox_policy_invalid rc 16, sandbox_not_ready rc 17, and include fenced true only after readiness
No routing, timeout threshold, lane order, or quota changes

milestones.title: Fake-pi regression arms and launchd test gate
acceptance_criteria: Fake-pi arms assert both -e flags, fence root, policy delivery, linked git metadata paths, readiness, and fail-closed verdicts without calling a model
Every arm names the mutation it kills and writes only under mktemp
Commit-count arm is reconciled with unmerged PR #1329 when available
git diff --check passes; in-sandbox gate verdicts are labeled UNINFORMATIVE and controller reruns gates outside sandbox
